narrationTexts: Two bugs to fix: `options.js` reads `options.retries` but callers now pass `retryCount`, and `retryPolicy.js` throws when `backoffEnabled` is `undefined` instead of treating it as disabled.
finalText:
**Build is clean now** — exit 0, 8 warnings, 0 errors.

The screen of warnings was mostly noise (deprecation notices from the bump), but the link stage had two real bugs from it:

1. [`src/core/options.js`](src/core/options.js) still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `retryCount`. It threw on `undefined.toFixed`.
2. [`src/net/retryPolicy.js`](src/net/retryPolicy.js) threw if `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so this tripped on every normal run. Now it just treats anything not `true` as disabled.

Next: nothing, `node build.js` exits clean.
